data.body: [P2] Preserve flushing after partial factory initialization. An application's `SpanProcessor.onStart` can throw here after the synthetic root has already ended. Because span creation now happens in the constructor, `PluginRunner` discards the failed instance and never invokes its End hook. A healthy `BatchSpanProcessor` therefore loses the flush previously performed after partial startup, potentially leaving completed telemetry buffered when Lambda freezes. Add failure cleanup to both OTel factories that flushes completed spans without shutting down the shared provider, preserving the original failure. Cover a failing Invocation start processor alongside a batch exporter.
